items.boundary: Default four-role developer bootstrap, attributed explicit lesson decisions, and executable version-bound gate across actual CLI/MCP and PostgreSQL; synthetic approvals only.
items.functional_requirement: Validate and publish an exact KB version with attributed approval; reject missing evidence and unauthorized callers.

items.boundary: Actual work-packet validation plus positive/negative contract fixtures.
items.functional_requirement: Execute bounded work-packet checks and validate positive and negative contract fixtures.

items.boundary: Live local adapters exercise source/validation/projection eligibility, recovery and hydration in disposable services.
items.functional_requirement: Exclude stale or quarantined KB content and verify authoritative source and index state.

items.boundary: Owned trace and immutable evidence; external unobserved actions remain outside trace coverage.
items.functional_requirement: Reconstruct task decisions and preserve exact successful, failed and unknown operation evidence.

items.boundary: All six test definitions and fixed metric queries; publication of real definitions requires its own decision.
items.functional_requirement: Validate, decide, index and query domain, capability and metric definitions.

items.boundary: Complete two-task synthetic transition and reuse path.
items.functional_requirement: Complete the two-task capture, validation, publication and reuse flow.

items.boundary: Actual pilot executable exercises malformed output, unchanged repair failure, deterministic recount, stale revision denial and successful Task B revision with retained exact artifacts. Protocol outputs are synthetic; real-model evidence remains in the retained pilot.
items.functional_requirement: Preserve failed repairs and accept only a bounded verified correction or revision.

items.boundary: Actual local verifier and behavior checks with deterministic patch fixtures; actual local-model quality is evidenced by the retained pilot, not these tests.
items.functional_requirement: Execute actual Git and Python verification in an isolated clone with deterministic generation fixtures.

items.boundary: Synthetic identity exercises exact approval. Existing real Task A approval is documented separately; test execution grants no real approval.
items.functional_requirement: Apply an explicit operator decision to the exact validated KB entry.

items.boundary: Actual worker publication and exact Milvus read-back; historical real-pilot publication remains separately recorded.
items.functional_requirement: Publish through the real worker and verify exact Milvus read-back.

items.boundary: Actual pilot executable completes retrieval, explicit use, failed Task B output and version-2 local revision without publishing Task B. Generated answers are deterministic fixtures; real-model quality is evidenced separately.
items.functional_requirement: Retrieve and use existing KB context, revise a failed task and leave its new KB entry pending.

items.boundary: Functional trace and metric behavior is tested through real local binaries; publication of retained real-pilot definitions is deferred rollout acceptance.
items.functional_requirement: Produce complete task traces and correct governed metrics after exact definition decisions.
deferred_acceptance: Publish the retained real-pilot definitions and run governed queries there when authenticated runtime access is available.

items.boundary: Self-provisioning isolated suite must execute all mapped checks; missing/skipped required tests fail the report.
items.functional_requirement: Provision disposable dependencies and require every mapped E2E test to execute successfully.

items.boundary: Migration/legacy-evidence regression and actual admin migration; protected local dump restore is separately documented, not rerun against live data.
items.functional_requirement: Upgrade migration-7 data without losing legacy evidence and run the actual migration CLI.

items.boundary: Matching built gateway/worker/admin and real policies start successfully in the disposable stack; no live cutover claimed.
items.functional_requirement: Start compatible gateway, worker, CLI and policies and preserve application state across restart.

items.boundary: Actual worker durable queue and actual local collector accept receipts.
items.functional_requirement: Export durable worker evidence to an actual local collector.

items.boundary: Mapped automated suite supplements required make check and documentation review; this is not a production readiness assertion.
items.functional_requirement: Expose the current tool and contract interfaces to the acceptance suite.

items.boundary: Disposable startup and restart prove local runtime behavior; existing live vault unlock and cutover are deferred rollout acceptance.
items.functional_requirement: Start and restart local services; retain checkpoints, pending KB entries, access denials and collector export.
deferred_acceptance: Unlock the existing vault and execute the prepared live cutover and target-service checks.

items.boundary: Actual CLI task issuance and HTTP revocation plus service expiry/live-authority cases; enterprise federation remains outside local certification.
items.functional_requirement: Issue scoped task credentials and enforce expiry, revocation and the issuer's current roles.

items.boundary: Tests existing mandatory authority gates only. Representative 7/14-day cohorts and accountable stage adoption cannot be replaced by synthetic tests.
items.functional_requirement: Enforce bounded local execution and immediately withdraw delegated access when authority expires or is revoked.
deferred_acceptance: Collect representative 7/14-day cohorts and record an evidence-backed adoption-stage decision. No automatic stage-promotion service is claimed.

items.boundary: Pending/raw access, validated publication and current eligible retrieval are exercised over MCP.
items.functional_requirement: Keep pending KB entries out of normal retrieval and serve only currently eligible approved versions.

items.boundary: Current applicable curation mechanism captures a pending lesson after reuse. Warehouse applicability remains the documented scoped decision.
items.functional_requirement: Capture the result of KB reuse as a pending proposed KB entry.

items.boundary: Exact-version duplicate inspection and foreign/quarantined exclusions with authoritative candidates; OCR/PDF and production corpus recall are outside supported scope.
items.functional_requirement: Inspect exact-version text quality and authoritative duplicates without exposing foreign or quarantined entries.

items.boundary: Executable stale-definition withdrawal and owner-attributed synthetic decisions; named deployment ownership and acceptance remain unspecified.
items.functional_requirement: Retain definition ownership and decision attribution; withdraw stale definitions and restore them through fresh validation.
deferred_acceptance: Assign and obtain acceptance from named deployment owners, QA and operations contacts and escalation replacements.

items.boundary: Local review/hold, immutable storage and collector export only. Production archival, hold authority and deletion requirements remain unspecified.
items.functional_requirement: Retain immutable local evidence, report review/hold obligations and preserve alerts and export through service restarts.
deferred_acceptance: Select production retention/storage/hold requirements, then implement and validate any required archival or deletion integration. The current functional scope is immutable retention with review/hold alerts.

items.boundary: Project isolation and configuration denials are local regression evidence. Target identity, cluster, storage and measured availability/recovery are still required.
items.functional_requirement: Enforce project isolation, reject invalid enterprise authentication settings and preserve denials after restart.
deferred_acceptance: Configure the target enterprise identity, tenant mapping, cluster and storage, then measure failover and recovery. Local tests do not implement or certify those target integrations.

items.boundary: Local source/verifier regressions supplement the retained rendered-overlay/read-only mount receipt; this run does not deploy Kubernetes.
items.functional_requirement: Verify local source freshness and enforce work-packet file boundaries in disposable clones.

items.boundary: Coverage loader requires all checklist IDs exactly once. Manual/production evidence limits are explicit per row.
items.functional_requirement: Bind every checklist item to executed checks and preserve evidence boundaries in the acceptance report.
